summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publishes a position statement denying that Anthropic supports banning open-weights models, and instead advocates for restricting advanced chip sales to China, cracking down on large-scale model distillation, and mandatory pre-release safety testing for all sufficiently capable models regardless of openness.

practices.reason: The advocacy for universal mandatory pre-release safety testing signals a direction for eval/safety-testing norms but describes no transferable method an engineering team could implement today.
practices.quote: All sufficiently capable models, open and closed, should go through mandatory safety testing.

notable_reason: A frontier lab CEO publicly rebuts an industry open letter and stakes out a detailed policy position on chip export controls, distillation crackdowns, and universal safety testing amid a live US policy debate on Chinese open-weights models.
